methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked. A GET (no body) makes req.json() reject, the .catch turns it into null, and the route answers 200 {"ok":true} (after auth).

auth.notes: Auth runs first and is NOT silent: an unauthenticated call gets 401, only the malformed-body path is silent.

request.parse: `await req.json().catch(() => null)`. Malformed JSON, empty body, or a body whose `events` is missing or not an array -> 200 {"ok":true} with no writes (no touchLastSeen either).

fields.name: events
fields.bounds: only the first 50 are processed; the rest are silently dropped

fields.name: events[].event_name
fields.validation: falsy -> the event is skipped silently, but still counted in `stored`

fields.name: page_exited properties: path, duration_seconds, scroll_depth_pct, referrer_path, session_id
fields.default: path: properties.path ?? page_path ?? ''; session: session_id ?? properties.session_id ?? ''; duration/scroll: the value only if typeof number, else null; referrer: ?? null
fields.validation: typeof checks only for the two numbers

request.unknownFields: Ignored at the top level and per event (only the fields above are read). Unknown keys inside `properties` are stored verbatim in analytics_events.properties jsonb.

checkOrder: 6. touchLastSeen + one insert per event, in parallel (:23-51)

responses.when: events array processed (including an empty array)

bodyShape.stored: integer = min(events.length, 50), counts skipped events too
bodyShape.at: ISO-8601 string, new Date().toISOString() taken before the writes

errors.when: only if something throws outside the swallowed DB errors (e.g. Supabase env missing). Insert errors do not produce 500.

sideEffects: profiles.last_seen_at = now for the caller on every valid batch; its error is ignored (db.ts:364-366).

event_name === 'page_exited' -> insert into page_view_sessions {user_id, session_id, path, exited_at: now, duration_seconds, scroll_depth_pct, referrer_path} (analytics-event.ts:31-41, db.ts:438-456).
Other events -> insert into analytics_events {user_id, session_id, event_name, properties, page_path} (analytics-event.ts:43-49, db.ts:400-415).
Insert errors are logged with console.error and swallowed (db.ts:414, 455).
quirks: Silent 200 {"ok":true} on a malformed body (no `stored`, no `at`), while a well-formed body gets {ok, stored, at}. The two success shapes differ.
`stored` is the sliced batch length, not the number actually written: events without event_name and failed inserts are still counted.
Batches over 50 are truncated silently; there is no error.
DB insert failures never surface; the route still answers ok.
page_exited events go to a different table (page_view_sessions), not analytics_events.
An empty events array still touches last_seen_at and returns stored: 0.
beforeAnyState: No prior state needed; works for any authenticated user.

callers.where: src/lib/analytics.ts:110-121 (_flushToSupabase, fetch keepalive POST {events}); events built at src/lib/analytics.ts:69-92 (page_exited with session_id in properties; others with properties.session_id)
callers.expects: Nothing: fire-and-forget, response and errors ignored (.catch(() => {})).

planSection65: Row '{events[] <=50} -> {ok, stored, at} (silent {ok:true} on a malformed body)' is accurate. Add: >50 are truncated not rejected; `stored` counts skipped events; 401 still applies.
